family.description: This entry, previously known as DUF2877, represents the Oxamate carbamoyltransferase subunit AllH and related bacterial proteins. AllH is a component of a carbamoyltransferase involved in the anaerobic nitrogen utilization via the assimilation of allantoin [[cite:PUB00155434]]. It catalyses the conversion of oxalurate (N-carbamoyl-2-oxoglycine) to oxamate and carbamoyl phosphate.
family.name: Oxamate carbamoyltransferase subunit AllH
